subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should structurally valid but low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic lifecycle policy and require explicit replacement approval?
rationale: Both unconditional automatic apply and conditional replacement approval are coherent product contracts; source inspection cannot determine which interruption-versus-safety tradeoff maintainers intend after the recent policy change.

options.title: Keep conditional replacement approval
options.body: Require explicit approval only for low-continuity updates while allowing substantially continuous edits to remain automatic.

options.title: Preserve unconditional automatic apply
options.body: Reject malformed content but allow every structurally valid proposal to follow the configured automatic policy.

options.title: Gate every update
options.body: Require approval for all update proposals, accepting a broader workflow regression for a simpler safety rule.

recommendation.title: Keep conditional replacement approval
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only for low-continuity updates while allowing substantially continuous edits to remain automatic.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the automatic-approval default whose contract would be narrowed by the PR.
